parsed.rationale: Every participating record lives in `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` and is a nested `SequentialMockSession` type inside test classes (`LastFMArtworkServiceTests`, `DiscogsArtworkServiceTests`, `iTunesArtworkServiceTests`). Per the restraint rules, any cluster containing a test-fixture record must be marked no-action. Additionally, the `members` array is empty and `shared_field_count` is 0, so there is no grounded field or method evidence to support synthesising a default implementation even if the restraint were lifted. Consolidating mock session helpers across test classes would couple unrelated test suites and obscure per-service test intent.
